name: code-commandments
title: Code Commandments
description: The architecture linter judges the codebase, and its hooks run inside the journal instead of beside it

php.hint: code-commandments runs on PHP 8.4 or newer

composer.hint: composer installs the linter inside the plugin's own folder

setup.name: Install the linter in the plugin's folder
Judge the codebase as a check
setup.run: journal check create "The codebase keeps its architecture" --set command=".journal/plugins/code-commandments/bin/commandments judge" --set every=0

quiet_hooks.title: Hooks that stay quiet
quiet_hooks.help: Names of the linter's hooks the journal should not run, separated by commas: JudgeReminder, SourceReminder, SkillReminder, ModelChoiceReminder, SharedBranchGate, SessionReset.
